overview: A throwable egg that turns a mob into its spawn egg. Throw it at anything the game has a spawn egg for and it leaves one behind.
It does not work on players, for obvious reasons.

2.1.0: The Ender Egg: the same throw, except it keeps the animal instead of the species.
The egg carries that mob's own name, variant, saddle, health and everything it held.
It is named after it, so a box of them can be read at a glance.
Missing is worth more: one throw in four does not break, and can be thrown again.
A miss that hatches chickens can hatch a flock.
The cleric's quest takes a blue or brown egg as well as a white one.
2.0.0: With Village Quests installed, a cleric describes a recipe nobody would reach by experiment.
You keep what you gathered, and afterwards they ask what it looked like when you threw one.
Every recipe brings the advancement that unlocks it.
Advancements say their words instead of a key the client cannot resolve.
1.1.1: Advancements for your first capture and for producing a lava chicken.
A throw that misses sometimes hatches something: usually a chicken, sometimes worse.
1.0.0: The magic egg: throw it at a mob and take its spawn egg.
Crafted from an egg, lapis lazuli and ender pearls. Blue and brown eggs work too.
